question: Roger Federer is a famous player of _________ sport.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lawn Tennis**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Roger Federer** is a famous player of** Lawn Tennis.**
 
• **Roger Federer** is widely regarded as one of the **greatest tennis players of all time.**
 
• He has achieved numerous accolades and records in his** tennis career, including winning a record 20 Grand Slam singles titles.**
 
• **Federer's skill, style, and sportsmanship have made him a beloved figure in the world of tennis.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football:**

 
 
• Football, also known as soccer in some countries, is a team sport played between two teams of eleven players each.
 
• The objective is to score goals by getting the ball into the opponent's net while adhering to specific rules. 
 
 
 
• **Rugby:**
 
 
• Rugby is a full-contact team sport that originated in England.
 
• It is played with an oval-shaped ball and features two teams of 15 players each (in Rugby Union) or 13 players each (in Rugby League). 
 
 
 
• **Lawn Bowls:**
 
 
• Lawn Bowls is a precision sport that involves rolling biased balls (known as bowls) on a grass or artificial turf surface called a bowling green.
 
• The objective is to get the bowls as close as possible to a smaller target ball called the jack.
